args.title: The Harbor Warehouse Pop-up
args.subtitle: An industrial sanctuary for the restless voyager.
args.line: Where the fog meets the harbor's forgotten pulse, you find the weight of timeless design.
args.synopsis: Step through the threshold of rusted chains into a thick, swirling mist. Your path takes you around the glowing amber lighthouse lens, its rhythmic light casting long, dancing shadows across the warehouse floor. As you explore the peripheral stations, the cold steel and rough textures tell a story of oceanic endurance. Finally, you reach the logbook desk at the back, leaving the fog behind with your chosen piece.
args.quote: In the stillness of the harbor, only the light remembers the way.

why.d: You begin your descent into the harbor by navigating through the heavy, hanging chains.
The lens guides your movement, pulling you into a slow, orbital journey of discovery.
Peripheral modules allow you to engage with the collection away from the central glow.
Your journey concludes at the desk where time seems to slow down and anchor.
